name: Bodhisattva Guanyin of the Lion's Roar
summary: This sculpture is a small masterpiece of serene composition. The poised calm of the Buddhist deity Guanyin (the Chinese goddess of mercy) is contrasted with the liveliness of the little lion leaping up playfully.
